jobs.title: Service Territory Operations Manager
jobs.location: Maspeth, New York, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description:

ITW Food Equipment Group LLC designs and manufactures commercial food equipment for food service and retail customers through its subsidiaries. The company’s products include ware washing equipment; cooking equipment, including ovens, ranges, and broilers; refrigeration equipment, including refrigerators, freezers, and prep tables; food processing equipment, including slicers, mixers, and scales; and kitchen exhaust, ventilation, and pollution control systems. ITW FEG has the largest service network in this industry to support our global customers, with highly specialized technicians and best-in-class supply chain procedures. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Troy, Ohio. ITW Food Equipment Group LLC is an Illinois Tool Works Inc. subsidiary.

SUMMARY
The Service Territory Operations Manager is responsible and accountable for leading and directing their assigned territory to achieve Service Annual Plan commitments and deliver ongoing service revenue growth, profitability, productivity, quality, and service levels. The Service Territory Operations Manager is also responsible for maintaining relationships across the Food Equipment Group enterprise including Field Sales Managers, Territory Installation Managers, Equipment sales teams, and major dealers who support FEG growth. The STOM ensures that the strategic direction for Service, as defined in Annual and Long-Range Plans, is carried out by the District Managers and territory Administrative/Customer Support functions per ITW’s policies and applicable laws .

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
These are the most significant job duties performed. The size, scope, and complexity of assigned duties and responsibilities are dependent on the level and experience of the incumbent. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each assigned essential duty satisfactorily. Other responsibilities or special projects not specifically listed below may also be assigned.

The major responsibilities of this role include:
- STRATEGIC LEADERSHIP: Support and implement goals aligned with the business's long-term plan, segmentation, and strategic direction as communicated by the Service Division Leadership team.  Drive the overall success of the territory. Anticipate local trends and implications accurately to create sustainable value.

- ACTION ORIENTED: Identify and seize new opportunities through strategic initiatives. Analyze performance data to recommend productivity, profitability, and customer satisfaction improvements.

- CUSTOMER FOCUS: Cultivate external relationships with clients and vendors, manage peer and territory-level customer relationships strategically, build solid connections, and ensure the delivery of customer-centric solutions aligned with strategic goals to reduce conflict and grow the business.

- BUILD NETWORKS: Collaborate with the Service Sales, National Accounts, Installation & Equipment Sales team in the territory to achieve service strategic objectives and support shared strategic objectives.  Recommends and makes data-driven strategic trade-off decisions within the territory. Maintains awareness of market dynamics impacting the districts.

- DEVELOP TALENT: Attract and select diverse and high-caliber leadership talent. Prioritize the development of others through coaching, feedback, exposure, and strategic career moves.

- FINANCIAL ACUMEN: Manage the P&L of the business strategically. Use financial analysis to generate, evaluate, and act on strategic options and opportunities.

- STRATEGIC MINDSET:    Demonstrate ability to analyze data and apply it to organizational strategies, drive simplification to all levels of the organization, be the point of contact for escalation concerns within the territory and be able to resolve complex issues strategically that impact current and future business needs.

- ORGANIZATIONAL KNOWLEDGE: Leads in keeping with ITW values and develops and maintains a working knowledge and use of the ITW toolbox.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required to perform this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Education and Work Experience
- Bachelor's degree and at least 8 years of leadership experience in a distributed service industry environment or equivalent experience

- Project Management Professional (PMP) or strong foundational knowledge of project management fundamentals

- Ability to communicate effectively with a wide audience range

- MS Office application proficiency to drive efficiency, productivity, and accuracy

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT
The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Physical Demands
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:
- Regularly required to sit

- Operates standard office equipment

Working Conditions
- Office or remote location environment

- Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate

Hours of Work
- Normal business hours with extended hours as needed

- Travel up to 50%

- Must be willing to relocate

The pay rate will depend on the successful candidate’s qualifications and prior experience. The range for this position is below: 119,880.00 - 199,800.00 USD Annual

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Manager
jobs.location: Kalkaska, Michigan, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Company Overview

Illinois Tool Works Inc. (ITW) is a Fortune 200 global manufacturing leader, founded in 1912, delivering specialized products and innovative solutions across diverse industries. With over $15.9 billion in revenue (2024), ITW operates with a decentralized business model focused on continuous improvement, operational excellence, and strong talent development across its global footprint.

Division Overview | ITW Specialty Films

ITW Specialty Films manufactures and markets specialized coated and metallized films used in Secure ID, Medical Specialty Bags, Financial Cards, Laminations, and Holographic applications. With multiple manufacturing facilities in the US, UK, and Germany, the division leverages core competencies in films, foils, holography, and laminates to meet complex customer needs.

ITW offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical plan options with FSA and HSA plans, dental, prescription drug, vision, 401(k) with a company match, life insurance, wellness programs, employee discounts, 12 paid holidays per year, vacation and sick time starting in year of hire, and a corporate matching gift program for charitable donations!  More information can be found here: https://myitwhr.com/

Position Summary

We are seeking a Continuous Improvement Manager - Manufacturing Excellence to play a key role in advancing our site’s operational performance at our Kalkaska, MI location. This high visible leadership role is responsible for driving continuous improvement, strengthening quality systems, enhancing equipment reliability, and building a culture rooted in ITW’s Business Model and 80/20 principles.

You will partner closely with Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, and Quality teams to deliver measurable results, improve processes, and develop scalable systems that support long-term success. This role is ideal for a hands-on, emerging leader who brings strong problem-solving skills, an operational mindset, and a passion for improving how work gets done.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence (40%)
- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and increase throughput

- Develop and execute a site-level CI roadmap tied to business goals and performance metrics

- Drive root cause analysis, corrective actions, and data-driven decision making

- Implement standardized processes, KPIs, and visual management systems

- Partner with Operations and Engineering to improve process capability and equipment performance

- Support new product introduction through stage-gate processes, FMEAs, and control plans
- Identify equipment upgrades and prepare capital expenditure requests

Quality Systems Leadership (20%)
- Lead and strengthen site quality systems and processes

- Support audits (internal and external), corrective actions, and compliance initiatives

- Promote a culture of quality ownership and continuous learning

- Partner cross-functionally to improve product consistency and customer satisfaction

Maintenance & Equipment Reliability (20%)
- Provide leadership and direction to maintenance and engineering support teams

- Improve preventive and predictive maintenance systems

- Drive initiatives that reduce downtime and improve equipment reliability

Safety & Compliance (10%)
- Support and champion a safe, compliant, and proactive work environment

- Partner with site leadership on OSHA, EPA, and EHS initiatives

- Participate in incident investigations, risk assessments, and prevention strategies

Leadership & Culture (10%)
- Build, coach, and develop team members across CI, Quality, and Maintenance

- Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

- Empower frontline teams with problem-solving tools and ownership mindset

- Align initiatives with broader divisional and enterprise priorities

QUALIFICATIONS

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to successfully perform in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
Required
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Industrial Technology, or related field

- 3+ years of experience in manufacturing, operations, engineering, or continuous improvement environments

- Demonstrated ability to analyze problems, identify root causes, and implement practical solutions

- Experience working in a fast-paced, hands-on manufacturing setting

- Strong communication skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and interact effectively with internal teams and external customers

- Proficiency in data analysis, performance metrics, and Microsoft Office (Excel required)

- Ability to balance floor presence with strategic improvement work

Preferred
- Exposure to Lean Manufacturing or similar operational excellence methodologies

- Experience leading projects, lean events, or cross-functional improvement initiatives

- Understanding of quality systems, audits, or regulatory compliance

- Experience partnering with or supporting maintenance and reliability programs

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

This role is based in a manufacturing facility and requires regular engagement on the production floor.
- Frequent interaction with production equipment, machinery, and active manufacturing processes

- Regular movement between office and production environments

- Required use of personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, hearing protection, and safety footwear

- Combination of standing, walking, observing processes, and computer-based work

- Requires visual focus and attention to detail when reviewing processes, equipment performance, and data

- Occasional lifting or light material handling may be required

- Work environment may include varying temperatures, noise levels, and industrial conditions typical of manufacturing sites

jobs.title: IT Operations Manager
jobs.location: Glenview, Illinois, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description:

ITW Construction North American provides solutions that build the spaces where we all live and work. Across the residential, commercial and renovation markets, we lead the construction industry in manufacturing a variety of products for wood, engineered lumber, concrete and steel. At ITW, we offer you a path for advancement, a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package designed to help employees care for themselves, their families, and their futures.

Purpose of the Role

As the IT Operations Manager, North America, you are responsible for security, systems, and technology delivery while providing IT thought leadership and direction for our platform, which includes 600+ employees operating across multiple facilities within the US. You will lead day‑to‑day IT operations for our North American businesses, work closely with Corporate IT to align with enterprise strategy and compliance requirements, and partner with business leaders to ensure technology effectively supports strategic goals, drives results, and improves business processes. In addition, you will oversee the operational and security aspects of IT Applications and infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

- Architecture Strategy & Alignment - Develop and implement a cohesive regional IT infrastructure strategy aligned with the Enterprise and Segment’s objectives, ensuring it accommodates the unique requirements of each division and plant.
- Standardize the IT architecture across divisions, integrating systems while ensuring minimal disruption to plant operations.
- Critical partner in overall ERP & Financial Data Management and will play a critical role in the implementation of all future business systems and tools

- Infrastructure Management   - Manage the regional IT infrastructure, ensuring high availability, reliability, and performance across all manufacturing plants.
- Oversee the implementation of networks, data centers, cloud solutions, and other infrastructure components across the region.
- Ensure proper maintenance, upgrading, and lifecycle management of IT hardware and software at each site.
- Lead initiatives to migrate and integrate legacy systems where feasible, balancing cost and operational efficiency.
- Lead IT infrastructure assessments and due diligence for consolidation and simplification.
- Develop roadmaps for unifying disparate IT environments, ensuring seamless connectivity and data flow between systems.
- Maintain operational continuity while driving the transition from legacy systems to modern, consolidated architecture.

- Identity and Access Management   - Oversee regional identity management systems, ensuring secure and efficient access control.
- Provide guidelines and supervise MSPs managing and maintaining account provisioning and trust relationships between legacy and modern systems.
- Lead effort to standardize IAM practices integrating disparate identify systems
- Implement robust authentication methods including single sign-on (SSO) multifactor authentication (MFA) and role-based access control (RBAC)
- Ensure compliance with data protection regulations (i.e. GDRP, CCPA) and internal policies related to identity and access management
- Perform regular audits and reviews of access permissions to identify and mitigate security risks

- Collaboration with Stakeholders - Build cross-department credibility, confidence, and collaboration with other functional areas within the Divisions via IT business partnership
- Work closely with manufacturing plant leadership, division heads, and other stakeholders to understand operational requirements and ensure IT solutions meet business needs.
- Keeps the organization’s vision and values at the forefront of decision-making and action

- Cybersecurity & Compliance   - Ensure all regional IT systems and infrastructure comply with ITW IT security policy.
- Work with Corporate cyber security team to implement best practices for protecting critical manufacturing systems from cyber threats.
- Conduct regular audits, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing across regional IT environments.

- Team Leadership & Vendor Management   - Builds and develops high-performing teams through coaching, performance management, succession planning, and targeted talent development initiatives.
- Provide guidance, mentorship, and professional development.
- Manage relationships with external vendors, contractors, and service providers to ensure the timely and cost-effective delivery of IT services.
- Oversee contracts and service-level agreements (SLAs) for infrastructure-related services in the region.

- Performance Monitoring & Reporting  - Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to track the performance and health of regional IT systems.
- Prepare regular reports for senior leadership, highlighting system performance, project progress, and any issues or risks.
- Implement tools and processes for proactive monitoring, issue detection, and problem resolution across IT environments.

- Innovation & Continuous Improvement  - Stay updated with the latest industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in IT infrastructure, cloud computing, and manufacturing technology.
- Proactively identify opportunities to enhance system efficiency, reduce costs, and support manufacturing innovation (e.g., IoT, AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics in production environments).
- Lead pilot projects and proof-of-concept initiatives that explore the potential benefits of new technologies.

Required Qualifications

- - Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science or related field of study
- 10+ years of IT experience with background in managing IT infrastructures in a multi-site context
- 3 years as a manager with direct reports
- 2 years with direct relationship management of major IT third-party vendors
- Experience in partnership supporting ERP systems
- Ability to utilize data to help determine focus and strategy
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to present operational status to senior leadership
- Must be able to multi-task, work under pressure and meet deadlines
- Demonstrated accountability for results and understanding of the financial impact of decisions with experience managing operational budgets and cost control
- Ability to travel domestically up to 10%

Technical Skills:
- - Network architecture, hardware
- Data center management
- Identity management
- Cloud computing

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a manufacturing environment

Compensation Information:
Annual base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $170,000 with bonus. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Company considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations. In addition, our benefits include paid vacation, sick, holiday, and parental leave. For more details, visit our Benefits page .

jobs.title: Operations Director
jobs.location: Glenview, Illinois, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description:

OPERATIONS DIRECTOR – MECHANICAL FASTENING

About ITW Mechanical Fastening
ITW Mechanical Fastening, a division of ITW Construction Products, is a global provider of premium fastening solutions that improve contractor productivity and building quality in the residential and renovation construction industries. Our portfolio includes category-leading brands such as GRK Fasteners™, Tapcon®, Red Head®, Ramset®, Rock-On®, Backer-On®, Teks®, and E-Z Ancor®. These trusted solutions help contractors work more efficiently while delivering superior performance on the jobsite.

About ITW
Founded in 1912, Illinois Tool Works Inc. is a Fortune 300 global multi-industry manufacturing leader with revenue of $16 billion in 2025. The company's seven industry-leading segments leverage the unique ITW Business Model to drive solid growth with best-in-class margins and returns in markets where highly innovative, customer-focused solutions are required. ITW's approximately 43,000 dedicated colleagues around the world thrive in the company's decentralized and entrepreneurial culture. ITW .

Why This Role Matters
As a key divisional leader, the Operations Director is responsible for developing and executing the long-term operations strategy that enables profitable growth across a significant business within the Construction segment. This role drives operational excellence by ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality products, in the right quantities to meet customer demand, while optimizing cost, productivity, and profitability in alignment with ITW's enterprise objectives.
The Operations Director provides strategic leadership and oversight across manufacturing, supply chain, sourcing, manufacturing engineering, safety, and quality functions spanning five locations (with the greater Chicago area). By leveraging ITW's business model and continuous improvement principles, the role ensures operational capabilities support growth, enhance customer satisfaction, and deliver sustainable business performance.

What You Will Do

- Develop and execute manufacturing strategies that ensure safe, efficient operations and consistent delivery of high-quality products.
- Establish and monitor key performance metrics to drive continuous improvement and exceed operational targets.
- Lead cross-functional quality initiatives, strengthen supplier accountability, and improve supplier and end-of-line quality performance.
- Oversee capital planning and execute operational CAPEX projects that enhance productivity, capacity, and growth.
- Partner with segment sourcing and supply chain teams to optimize supply chain and distribution performance.
- Drive productivity improvements and cost reductions through the application of the ITW Toolbox and continuous improvement principles.
- Manage supply chain performance through strategic sourcing, supplier partnerships, inventory optimization, and transportation cost control.
- Improve conversion costs by reducing waste, scrap, rework, and other operational inefficiencies.
- Enhance delivery performance and inventory optimization through strong MRD practices across manufactured and purchased products.
- Drive collaboration with engineering, marketing, and sourcing teams to ensure successful new product introductions on time and on cost.
- Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements and company standards.
- Foster a high-performance culture through effective communication, employee engagement, coaching, and leadership development.
- Build organizational capability by developing Operations, Engineering, and Supply Chain leaders and driving succession planning.
- Champion a world-class safety culture through proactive risk identification, mitigation, and employee accountability.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

What You Bring

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
- 15+ years of progressive operations leadership experience in complex manufacturing environments, including multi-site responsibility.
- Proven success leading manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, warehousing, and safety functions while delivering strong business and financial results.
- Demonstrated ability to develop and execute operational strategies that drive growth, productivity, customer service, and margin improvement.
- Strong financial and business acumen, including experience managing budgets, capital investments, cost reduction, and operational performance metrics.
- Proven track record of building high-performing teams, developing leaders, and driving organizational capability through coaching and succession planning.
- Experience leading supply chain optimization, supplier quality improvement, and large-scale operational or business transformation initiatives.
- Strong change management, project management, and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to influence and drive results across organizational boundaries.
- Deep commitment to safety, quality, compliance, and continuous improvement, with experience relevant operating disciplines.
- Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to effectively engage employees, customers, suppliers, and senior leadership.
- Willingness to travel regularly to operating locations, with occasional international travel as needed.

What's In It for You

This is a highly visible leadership opportunity to shape the operational strategy and long-term success of a significant business within ITW's Construction segment. As a key member of the Division Leadership Team, you will have the autonomy to drive operational excellence across multiple sites while influencing business performance, customer satisfaction, and profitable growth. You will lead a diverse organization spanning manufacturing, supply chain, sourcing, engineering, quality, and safety, while leveraging the ITW Business Model to deliver meaningful results.Beyond driving business outcomes, you will have the opportunity to build high-performing teams, develop the next generation of operations leaders, and lead transformational initiatives that create lasting impact across the organization. Most importantly, you will be part of ITW's unique entrepreneurial culture, where leaders are empowered to make decisions, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Guided by ITW's core values of Integrity, Respect, Trust, Shared Risk, and Simplicity, you will help foster an environment where people thrive, customers succeed, and businesses grow sustainably.  Learn more at ITW Careers .

Work Environment

This position is based in our Glenview corporate office; however, the employee may be required to work in a variety of locations, including but not limited to construction/job sites, supplier locations, test laboratories, and manufacturing facilities. These environments may not be controlled by the Company and may require the use of personal protective equipment (PPE). While performing the duties of this position, the employee may occasionally be exposed to fumes, airborne particles, climate variations, and moving mechanical equipment typically found in construction and manufacturing environments. The noise level in the corporate office is generally low; however, noise levels may be significantly higher when visiting job sites, test laboratories, or manufacturing facilities. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. The work environment characteristics described herein are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential duties and responsibilities of this role.
All applicant information will be kept confidential in accordance with EEO guidelines.

Compensation Information:
The salary range for this position is $190,000-$ 230,000 annually. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. The company considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations. The position is also eligible to participate in ITW’s incentive programs.

jobs.location: Libertyville, Illinois, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Company Description
ITW’s products and solutions are at work all over the world - in deep-sea oil rigs, aerospace technology, bridges and wind turbines, healthcare, the spaces in which we live and work, the cars we drive, and the mobile devices we rely on. You are never, whether you know it or not, more than a few steps from an innovative ITW solution. In the words of a Mal Pancoast quote, at ITW, "You get paid to impact the world."
ITW Construction provides a variety of fastening systems and truss products for the commercial, residential, and remodeling/renovation segments. With products manufactured at locations around the globe serving markets in North America, Europe, Asia, New Zealand and Australia. The Global Tool Unit (GTU) is a part of ITW’s Construction Segment. The GTU innovates, develops, and manufactures best-in-class Power Fastening Systems for the global construction market.  Our highly differentiated tools are specified to be used in a variety of applications including wood framing, wood trim, and steel to concrete installations.

Job Description
The Operations Director is responsible for manufacturing, supply chain, sourcing, safety and quality for two sites.  The role drives key plant performance metrics to ensures timely delivery of a quality product, in quantities that meet demand from the divisions and at a cost that insures profitability and growth consistent with ITW objectives.  The following functions will report into this position- Quality, 2 Manufacturing plants, Continuous Improvement and Sourcing.
- Develop robust manufacturing plans to establish procedures for maintaining high standards of manufacturing operations to ensure that products conform to established customer and company quality standards.  (Manufacturing locations are Libertyville, IL, Pontotoc, MS)

- Define key performance metrics and monitor performance to exceed KPI targets.

- Manage cross-functional quality improvement activities with Quality and Assembly teams, ensuring supplier accountability for upstream quality, reducing defects and production interruptions, and achieving established supplier PPM and end-of-line quality objectives.

- Ensure compliance with company needs for capital investments and improvement projects and execute on all operational CAPEX projects.

- Collaborate across the segment by working with the global divisions to implement strategies and action plans that deliver the most efficient and effective supply chain and distribution.

- Consistently reduces costs through productivity gains.

- Manage supply chain delivery performance by developing supplier stocking agreements, driving strategic supplier selection, controlling transportation costs through reduced air freight utilization, and maintaining inventory levels within agreed minimum and maximum thresholds.

- Apply the ITW toolbox to identify, recommend and implement changes to improve conversion costs through productivity, cost, scrap and rework reduction.

- Increase quality of practice of MRD in manufactured and purchased products to achieve excellent delivery service while optimizing inventory levels.

- Closely collaborate with engineering, marketing and sourcing teams to ensure proper launch of new products with the expected cost and timing.

- Manage compliance with state and federal regulations and company standards.

- Provide leadership for employee relations through effective communications, coaching, training and development.

- Drive talent development across the Operations organization by coaching and developing Plant, Quality, and Supply Chain leaders, expanding leadership responsibilities, and implementing succession and development plans.

- Develop and sustain a high-performance safety culture by leading hazard identification and mitigation efforts across Assembly, Maintenance, and Continuous Improvement functions, while driving employee engagement and accountability for workplace safety.

- Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s Degree – Preferably in Engineering, Supply Chain or Operations, Preferred Mechanical Engineer and Masters or MBA.

- 10+ years of related experience in a manufacturing environment.

- Proven business results of improving operational performance and key financial metrics

- 5+ years of building, leading, and developing high-performing teams in a complex manufacturing environment.

- Demonstrated success in talent management, succession planning, and leadership development, with the ability to build a strong pipeline of future operational leaders.

- Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive business results without direct authority across divisional, customer, and organizational boundaries.

- Proven ability to foster a culture of continuous improvement by engaging and empowering employees at all levels to identify opportunities and implement best practices.

- Demonstrate project management experience.

- Working knowledge of local and federal governmental requirements (OSHA)

- Position requires regular travel.

jobs.title: Operations Director
jobs.location: Tucker, Georgia, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Company Overview
The ITW Fluids North America Division is a manufacturer of lubricants, cleaning chemicals, and corrosion preventatives formulated to maximize equipment productivity and product quality for customers. ITW Fluids Division includes five facilities in the United States and is a division of Illinois Tool Works, a Fortune 150 company.  We go to market through B2B with a focus on the automotive, aviation, fabricated metal, food processing and machinery manufacturing market segments. Offering a brand portfolio that is well recognized within these industrial channels, our premium products address customer pain points and our direct sales team provide expert value-added consulting at the customer level. ITW Pro Brands has 250 employees and 4 manufacturing facilities in: Olathe, KS, Tucker, GA, Easton, MD, and DeWitt, IA.

Our Values:
- Simplicity : focusing on the essential core of each business opportunity, guided by the “80/20” rule to streamline processes, systems and structures.
- Shared risk : collaborating as a team, taking joint responsibility, and learning from trial and error to drive innovation.
- Integrity : honesty, transparency, and doing the right thing in all business dealings, regardless of brand and location.
- Respect : valuing diversity in cultural backgrounds and fostering an open environment where innovation can thrive.
- Trust : relying on employees to uphold the highest professional standards and act in the company’s best interests.

What We Offer:
ITW’s benefits package is designed to provide comprehensive support for physical, mental, and financial well-being including healthcare, retirement planning, paid leave, wellness programs, and opportunities for charitable involvement.

Position Summary :
The Director of Operations provides overall direction, strategy, and planning for the division’s manufacturing facilities.  The Director of Operations, in partnership with the Plant Managers, will have overall responsibility for manufacturing operations at each facility to include manufacturing, shipping/receiving, quality, regulatory, EHS, maintenance, engineering, strategic sourcing and customer service.

Core Responsibilities
- Develop team members through coaching, feedback, and performance reviews
- Promote a strong culture of quality, safety, and environmental compliance
- Set strategic direction to improve profitability, productivity, and efficiency
- Define site goals and ensure effective use of resources
- Build and execute functional strategies and annual plans with site and EHS leaders
- Partner across teams on innovation and new product development
- Drive continuous improvement using established tools and practices by championing ITW toolbox initiatives for manufacturing operations.
- Direct and report on performance against operational metrics: Safety/Cost/ Quality
- Lead global sourcing efforts to meet division goals

jobs.location: Appleton, Wisconsin, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Reporting to the Director of Operations, the Operations Manager will be responsible for driving results in key areas of safety, quality, productivity, delivery, and continuous improvement for the Industrial Equipment and Automation division.  This position will have responsibility for multiple manufacturing operations in Appleton and partnerships with equipment contract manufacturers in US locations.  The role requires a strong, enterprise-minded leader who will further develop a safety-first culture, strengthen the ITW Toolbox operations strategy, build a diverse talent pipeline, and lead continuous improvement initiatives across internal operations, key suppliers, and contract manufacturers.

Responsibilities include :
- Manages a team of production leaders and supports the development and execution of plans to improve safety, quality, labor efficiency, and inventory improvements.

- Manages and strengthens relationships with contract manufacturers and key suppliers for automation systems.

- Establishes short- and long-term operational objectives and develops plans to achieve production and business goals, including budget and capital requirements.

- Reviews, revises, and approves budget proposals from direct reports and submits budgets for assigned areas in accordance with established procedures.

- Uses sales, inventory metrics, and forecasts to create robust operational plans

- Partners with supply chain on strategic sourcing initiatives that improve supply continuity, cost competitiveness, and operations scalability.

- Hires, develops, and retains a diverse team while building a strong talent pipeline and supporting career development.

- Communicates company and department plans, priorities, and performance progress to employees and key stakeholders

- Fosters a culture of accountability, engagement, inclusion, and continuous improvement while developing a flexible, responsive workforce.

- Collaborates with cross-divisional teams to identify best practices and leverage shared operational capabilities and overall business growth

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree: Operations Management, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or similar field required.

- Minimum of 7-10 years of relevant and progressive manufacturing management experience including leading production/direct labor

- Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities for improvement, facilitate change, and develop innovative solutions to improve workflows and processes within the ITW Business Model.

- Proven ability to independently lead cross-functional improvements, apply analytical and root cause problem-solving skills, and deliver measurable results

- Understands a variety of operational excellence competencies including but not limited to:  ITW Toolbox, Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma, Visual Management, Value Stream Mapping, Standard Work, Kaizen, Poke Yoke, etc.

- Ability to build strong relationships with internal and external business partners and executive-level leaders, influence without authority, and effectively manage stakeholder expectations.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication/presentation skills with a strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.

- Ability to travel up to 20% since some direct reports and equipment contract manufacturers are in other locations (Tennessee, California, Michigan, Ohio, Illinois)

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience leading leaders with direct reports

- P&L experience , including inventory management, budgeting, and planning capabilities

- Previous ERP experience strongly preferred.

Key Competencies
- Strong leadership skills: leads both people and change effectively

- Result-driven, accountability focused – holds self and others responsible for delivering results and modeling ITW Leadership Expectations

- Strategic Vision – ability to progressively lead an organization towards the achievement of short and long-term strategic objectives, anticipating future change implications and impacts

- Strong business acumen paired with enterprise-first mindset (across all functional areas and the ITW Welding segment) – proactively collaborates to solve problems effectively across all levels

Why ITW Welding?
Join a collaborative and growth-focused team where your expertise will directly impact the company’s financial health and operational success. We value innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Here’s what we offer to help you build the future you want:
- Generous Retirement Benefits –  401(k) match PLUS an additional retirement contribution to help you plan for the future.

- Paid Time Off –  11 paid holidays, 5 sick days, and vacation time to take time for what matters.

- Company-Paid Insurance –  Life, AD&D, Short-Term & Long-Term Disability insurance to give you peace of mind.

- Family-Friendly Benefits –  4 weeks of paid parental leave and adoption reimbursement to support your family journey.

- Education Assistance –  tuition reimbursement because we believe in investing in your personal and professional development.

At ITW Welding, we’re not just a place to work – we’re a community that empowers you to grow and make a real impact. Join us and build a career that makes a difference!

Company Description
Comprised of a market-leading portfolio of best-in-class brands, the businesses of ITW Welding work together to provide premium performance delivered through a breadth of solutions encompassing welding, cutting, consumables, and accessories.  ITW Welding North America represents Miller Electric Welding Equipment, Safety & Accessories, Hobart Filler Metals, and Bernard / Tregaskiss MIG Guns.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Job Description:

BUSINESS DESCRIPTION

ITW (NYSE: ITW) is a Fortune 200 global multi-industrial manufacturing leader with revenues totaling $15.9 billion in 2024. The company’s seven industry-leading segments leverage the unique ITW Business Model to drive solid growth with best-in-class margins and returns in markets where highly innovative, customer-focused solutions are required. ITW’s approximately 43,000 dedicated colleagues around the world thrive in the company’s decentralized and entrepreneurial culture. To learn more about the company and the ITW Business Model, visit www.itw.com.

Position Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Financial Controller to join our Finance team in AAME. This role will act as a key business partner, driving financial performance, ensuring compliance, and supporting strategic decision-making. The Financial Controller will leverage ITW Toolbox principles to drive growth and operational excellence.

Responsibilities
Operating Analysis and Planning:
- Deliver short and long-term financial forecasting and planning.

- Analyze market trends.

- Support on driving optimization on working capital by improving inventory turnover, DSO, and DPO.

- Provide financial support for new product development (CBI), including costing, pricing, and post-launch performance tracking.

- Apply ITW Principles (80/20, Product Line Simplification, Segmentation, In-lining, Market Rate of Demand) to drive growth and eliminate complexity.

- Support on evaluating investment opportunities.

Financial Reporting and Controls:
- Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting in compliance with ITW policies and US GAAP.

- Oversee the monthly closing process and prepare financial statements and analysis.

- Develop and maintain robust KPI dashboards to support effective business management.

- Maintain strong internal controls and ensure compliance with financial policies • Communicate financial insights clearly to support strategic decisions.

Strategic Planning:
- Contribute to develop and execute Annual and Long Range Plans based on in-depth understanding of business and operations.

- Participate to FTB 80/20 process to help develop a vision and support implementation of strategic plans.

- Build cross-department credibility, confidence, and collaboration with other functional areas.

People Leadership and Talent Development:
- Identify, lead and develop talent in order to maximize individual, team and organizational effectiveness in meeting company goals. This may include: selecting and on-boarding talent; communicating effectively to foster a culture of engagement, cascading vision, creating goal alignment, and coaching through feedback, development planning and performance management

- Use personal influence skills rather than position power to persuade others and gain acceptance of ideas and plans.

- Build a strong pipeline of talent to ensure a diverse high performing organization

Job Requirements
- Master’s Degree in Finance required (or equivalent work experience)

- 6+ years of demonstrated experience in financial reporting and analysis, cost reduction, inventory control, tracking and managing costs against a budget, and tracking P&L results required

- Ability to exercise independent and sound judgment and solve practical business problems in a prompt manner and often under tight deadlines.

- Ability to troubleshoot and manage the risks inherent in growth initiatives that support division strategies.

- Strong influence and collaboration skills.

- Ability to work in a diverse and multicultural environment.

- Ability to shift priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

- Strong IT knowledge with excellent computer skills (MS Excel, Power Point, and General Ledger applications).

- Travel up to 10%

Additional Information
- Contract type: permanent

- Starting date: asap
